summary.text: Marty Foncello was first elected in 2022 to represent the 107th District, serving Brookfield, part of Bethel and part of Newtown.

paragraphs.text: He was elected First Selectman of Brookfield in 1999 and served two terms.
He served as an Army officer for 28 years, retiring in 2002 as a lieutenant colonel, mostly in military intelligence.
He later worked as a senior intelligence officer with the Department of Homeland Security's Office of Intelligence and Analysis.
